I checked the 93 rows that carry gold, silver1/2, a pairing other than "no", or full/mixed coverage, plus the held rows that hint at whole-spine fields.

But every one is lumbar, lumbosacral or pelvic, so silver1 (Ljubljana, 1) and silver2 are the ceiling.
